findings.evidence: calculateMonthBudgetBreakdown skips every expense that is not PLANNED/CONFIRMED (`!isBudgetCounted(expense) ... continue`) before `coveredTemplateIds.add(expense.template_id)`, so a CANCELLED expense generated from a MONTHLY_DAY template never marks that template as covered for the month. This matches the spec text (covered = PLANNED or CONFIRMED) and the unit tests, but the template then falls into the 'not yet generated' loop (lines 140-145) and its default_price is added to plannedFixedAmount.
findings.impact: If a user cancels one month's generated subscription expense while the template stays active, ensureMonthlySubscriptionExpenses does not regenerate it (duplicate-ignoring upsert), yet the two-month card still adds the template's default_price for that month. The card then over-states 예상 총 지출 and under-states 예상 잔여 예산 for that month. Display only, no ledger or RPC effect.
findings.recommendation: Optional follow-up: also add template_id of CANCELLED expenses of the same budget month to coveredTemplateIds (without counting their amount) and add a unit test; if the product wants cancelled months to still show the fixed cost, record that decision in docs/r101-r103-budget-presets-shortcuts-spec.md. Not blocking for merge.
